rows.question: Which of these notes explains the difference between kW and kWh, and in one sentence what is the difference?

sources.title: Power and energy: kW versus kWh
sources.passage: Power expresses the rate at which energy is consumed or produced. It is measured in watts (W) or kilowatts (kW): one kilowatt equals one thousand watts. Energy consumed over an interval can be expressed in watt-hours (Wh) or kilowatt-hours (kWh).

sources.title: Power and energy: kW versus kWh
sources.passage: If power remains constant, energy is power multiplied by time. For example, a 100 W appliance running for three hours consumes 300 Wh, or 0.3 kWh. This calculated example illustrates why kW and kWh are not interchangeable.

sources.title: Compass: orientation and the magnetic field
